title: Release builds ship the local engine; the slim build refuses the starter install plainly
goal: Qualification requires real local Candle generations, but since T-GROKSLIM1104-1 the default graph leaves the engine out and every release step built with --no-default-features only. Select the product features (local-engine) in every release step, and make the engine-less build refuse the starter install before downloading instead of failing with a misleading transfer error.

criteria: every release step selects --no-default-features --features local-engine for a workspace that declares it
local-release check-inference passes on a local-build debug candidate with an uncached model download
install starter in a build without the engine refuses before any download
